message.reasoning:
We need to decide whether to buy Electric Company for $150. Player p1 (Alpha) has cash 145, which is less than price 150. So cannot afford to buy. In Monopoly, you cannot buy if you don't have enough cash. So must start auction. The tool start_auction requires private_thought and public_message.

We should note that we cannot buy due to insufficient cash. So we will start auction.

Public message: maybe say "I'll start auction." Could also try to influence others. But keep concise.

Private thoughts: note cash shortage, need to raise cash, maybe consider mortgage later, etc.

Make tool call start_auction.
